summary: Three-band equaliser with tube-style drive: each band has a boost or cut of plus or minus 16 dB, an overdrive amount, a centre frequency, a width and one of six circuit models (transistors, tubes I, tubes II, each plain or warm). For warm, coloured tone shaping.
use_for: Band boosts with tube-style drive for warm, coloured tone shaping.
quirks: Bands 2 and 3 carry band 1's descriptions in the machine's own texts (a copy mistake in the machine); the names Band 1, 2, 3 here follow their order.
The bands default to 0 dB boost, 25 percent drive and centres near 60 Hz, 630 Hz and 6.3 kHz (read from the measured mapping).
Boost at its maximum is hot: +4.7 dBFS peak for band 3 at +16 dB on the profile's signal.
Level is 0 dB at the defaults; stereo.
Closed source: names and behaviour come from its own texts and documentation page and from measurements, not from code.

parameters.name: 1. Boost
parameters.description: Band 1's boost or cut, -16 to +16 dB (its own text says band 1 for every band).
parameters.how: Sets band 1's boost or cut from -16 dB to +16 dB in 64 steps; the middle step is 0 dB.
parameters.sound: Boost to bring the band forward and add tube warmth when Drive is up; cut to take it out.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Tube overdrive of band 1, 0 to 100 percent (its own text says band 1).
parameters.how: Sets how much tube-style overdrive band 1 adds, 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: More drive adds soft, even harmonics and thickness to the band; at 0 it is a clean equaliser.

parameters.name: Freq
parameters.description: Centre frequency of band 1, 19.6 Hz to 20 kHz (its own text says band 1).
parameters.how: Sets band 1's centre frequency, about 20 Hz to 20 kHz on an exponential scale.
parameters.sound: Move it to the part of the spectrum you want to colour.

parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: Width of band 1, 0.1 to 5 octaves (its own text says band 1).
parameters.how: Sets band 1's width, about 0.1 to 5 octaves.
parameters.sound: Narrow bands are surgical; wide ones are broad tone shaping.

parameters.name: Mode _______________________
parameters.description: Circuit model of band 1 (its own text says band 1).
parameters.how: Chooses band 1's circuit model: transistors, tubes I or tubes II, each plain or warm.
parameters.sound: Transistors are tighter, the tube models rounder and more coloured, and warm versions add more saturation.
